simple.meaning: מָגוּר (mâgûwr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a temporary abode ; by extension, a permanent residence.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מָגוּר (H4033) appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 17:8, with occurrences in Genesis, Exodus, Job, Psalms, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָגוּר (H4033) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מָגוּר (H4033) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מָגוּר (mâgûwr) / H4033 is traced through Genesis 17:8, Genesis 28:4, Genesis 36:7, Genesis 37:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a temporary abode ; by extension, a permanent residence
definitions.usage: dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger. Compare 4032 .
definitions.full: H4033. magor or magur [ מָגוֺר ] noun [masculine] sojourning-place, dwelling-place , sojourning — suffix ם מְגוּרָ Psa 55:16 ; plural construct מְגוּרֵי Gen 37:1 ; suffix מְגוּרַי 47:9 , מְגוּרָי֑ Psa 119:54 , מְגֻרֶיךָ Gen 17:8 ; 28:4 , מְגוּרָיו Job 18:19 , מְגוּרֵיהֶם Gen 36:7 2 t. מְגֻרֵיהֶם Exod 6:4 ; — dwelling-place Psa 55:16 ; Job 18:19 ; — sojourning( -place) , always plural מ ׳אֶרֶץ Gen 17:8 ; 28:4 ; 36:7 ; 37:1 ; Exod 6:4 (Hexateuch always P) Ezek 20:38 ; sojourning (plural) = life time, מ ׳שְׁנֵי Gen 47:9 מ ׳יְמֵי 47:9 ; compare מ ׳בֵּית Psa 119:54 .
definitions.rootNote: or מָגֻר ; from 1481 in the sense of lodging;
